about: Status of each environment .blend. Written by hand; checked by tools/blender/environment_sources.py --check. Statuses: adopted, scaffold, superseded (with supersededBy), reference.

alicias_padaria.blend.basis: Source of both shipped Padaria packages, alicias_padaria (plate) and alicias_padaria_3d; docs/reports/st-maria-shops-walkable-2026-08-27.md records it as source authority. Recorded from repo evidence, not yet owner-confirmed.

img2imgguide.blend.basis: Added by the spatial-seam spike (aef2c7ba); no recipe writes it and no package or tool cites it.

lauras_smith.blend.basis: Source of both shipped smith packages, lauras_smith (plate) and lauras_smith_3d; docs/reports/st-maria-shops-walkable-2026-08-27.md records it as source authority. Recorded from repo evidence, not yet owner-confirmed.

passage_house_corridor.blend.basis: Written by recipes/passage_house_corridor.py; no shipped package is baked from it, and no adoption is recorded.

passage_house_room3.blend.basis: Written by recipes/passage_house_room3.py (regenerated to the Classic 256 preset at 689ccb83); no shipped package is baked from it, and no adoption is recorded.

st_maria_port_spatial_reference.blend.basis: Added by the spatial-seam spike (aef2c7ba); no recipe writes it and no package or tool cites it.

st_maria_praca.blend.basis: 572-triangle scaffold restored deliberately at 06305e79; nothing shipped is baked from it (a52a411c: two sources with different purposes, not two revisions). The six Praca tools that target it are scaffold-only.
st_maria_praca.blend.notes: Docs that call this file authoritative or owner-authored predate the split and are corrected by #1269.

st_maria_praca_modelled.blend.basis: The shipped Praca package (praca/environment.json, environmentId st_maria_praca_modelled) is baked from this file; modelled exterior, 65 meshes, composed through the house grammar (a52a411c, #1021).
